title: Canonical completed tensor comparison on one strict Roos representative
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-dimensional extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ in the coefficient universe, an isomorphism $g:X\to Y$ on which $\ell$ is invertible at every residue field, and normalized completion reindexing data $D$ satisfying all Laws of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]. Let $P,Q$ be flat-term K-flat complexes on $Y$ whose localized objects are complete constructible. Let $\tau$ be an isomorphism from the reindexing of their strict finite tensor-reduction tower to the tensor-reduction tower of their reindexed complexes. Suppose that for every quotient $n$, degrees $p,q$, site object $U$ and sections $x,y$, its degree-$(p+q)$ map sends the homogeneous tensor section of $x,y$ to the homogeneous tensor section of $D.quotient(P)(x),D.quotient(Q)(y)$, as in the Generators formula of [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models]. Write $L$ for reindexing of the completed-tensor representative comparison followed by the localization factorization, $Q(D.roos)$ and $Q(Roos(\tau))$. Write $e$ for the completed tensor of the two localization factorization isomorphisms followed by the target completed-tensor representative comparison. Write $\beta$ for the specified ordinary-to-completed pullback map. Then $L\circ e^{-1}\circ(\beta_P\widehat\otimes\beta_Q)=\beta_{P\widehat\otimes Q}\circ c_{P,Q}$, with composition read left-to-right, where $c$ is the canonical completed pullback/tensor comparison of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-construction]. All representative comparisons are the existing integralCompletedTensorComparison; no independent derived tensor family is part of this assertion.

proof.text: At every quotient, use the normalized sectionwise tensor comparison conjugated by D.quotient for P and Q. Compare it with the supplied tower arrow on homogeneous pure-tensor sections. Pure-tensor sheaf extensionality and the direct-sum total inclusions identify the chain maps. The given tower arrow already commutes with every quotient transition.

proof.text: Apply the actual Roos functor to this equality of strict towers. D.RoosFst and D.RoosSnd identify both cone coordinates, and D.FiniteModel and D.LimitModel give the specified localization comparisons. Use the fixed pullbackTensorIntegralTensorNormalization from the full integral tensor/Roos realization to identify the completed tensor representative comparisons. On the coherent reduction systems, substitute the defining canonical completed comparison, formed by the full reduction/limit counits and the system tensor comparison. D.Unit, D.Counit and D.PullbackNormalization identify its ordinary-to-completed maps. Transport the two inputs along mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the target tensor comparison to obtain the displayed equation.

theorem podTensorRoosRepresentativeSquare
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (hP : sfIntegralConstructible l E Y (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
    (hQ : sfIntegralConstructible l E Y (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj))
    (τ : (podReindexTower l E g).obj
        ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y).obj (P.obj,Q.obj)) ≅
      (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).obj
        (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj,((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj))
    (hgen : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (U : X.ProEt)
      (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P.obj).X p).val.obj
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
      (y : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X q).val.obj
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
      ((((τ.hom.app (op n)).f (p + q)).val.app (op U)))
          (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E Y n P.obj Q.obj p q
            (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) x y) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n
          (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj) (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj)
          p q (op U) ((((D.quotient P.obj P.property n).hom.f p).val.app (op U)) x)
            ((((D.quotient Q.obj Q.property n).hom.f q).val.app (op U)) y)) :
    letI : (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).Additive :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_additive.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_limits.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g) :=
      isoSectionwiseModuleInverseImage_colimits.{u, u} g (isoReductionCompletedMap l E g).hom
    ((podOrdinaryReindex l E g).map
          ((integralCompletedTensorComparison l E Y).hom.app (P,Q)) ≫
        (isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app _ ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((D.roos ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y).obj (P.obj,Q.obj))).hom ≫
            integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map τ.hom)) ≫
      (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E X).inv.app
        ((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P,(podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q) ≫
      (integralCompletedTensor l E X).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app P.obj)
          ((isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app Q.obj)) ≫
      (integralCompletedTensor l E X).map
        (Prod.mkHom
          ((podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj))
          ((podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj))) =
    (podOrdinaryToCompleted l E g D).app
        ((integralCompletedTensor l E Y).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj,DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)) ≫
      ((canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E g ⟨_,hP⟩ ⟨_,hQ⟩).hom).hom
